scope: All 16 standing committees elected on 1979-10-09 and subsequent changes before the 1982-10-12 full election; the published Justitieutskottet pilot is preserved without duplicate additions

rule_references.use: Confirmed elections, term continuity, parliamentary eligibility and approved resignations
The 1979 committee election covers the parliamentary term, not only the annual session
Leave cover is separately elected; original appointees do not lose their assignments merely by taking leave
Use contemporary rules rather than later consolidated wording

Moderata samlingspartiets partigrupp har som suppleant i trafikutskottet under Rolf Clarksons ledighet anmält hans ersättare Berit Mohlin-Erbeus samt som suppleant i utrikesoch arbetsmarknadsutskotten under Carl Bildts ledighet anmält hans ersättare Filip Fridolfsson.

Onsdagen den Wahlbergs ledighet anmält hennes ersättare Ylva Annerstedt.
